summary.story: YOLO (Chinese: 热辣滚烫; pinyin: Rè là gǔntàng; lit. 'A Hot', 'Spicy', 'Boiling', 'Burning [Life]') is a 2024 Chinese comedy-drama film directed by Jia Ling and starring Jia and Lei Jiayin. A comedic adaptation of the 2014 Japanese film 100 Yen Love, it tells the story of Du Leying who has stayed at home for many years, and after meeting boxing coach Hao Kun overcomes the challenges that follow and starts a new life.

'A Hot', 'Spicy', 'Boiling', 'Burning [Life]') is a 2024 Chinese comedy-drama film directed by Jia Ling and starring Jia and Lei Jiayin. A comedic adaptation of the 2014 Japanese film 100 Yen Love, it tells the story of Du Leying who has stayed at home for many years, and after meeting boxing coach Hao Kun overcomes the challenges that follow and starts a new life. YOLO grossed $484.5 million worldwide, making it the highest-grossing Chinese film in 2024.
